# Test-track sample sets: provenance

Generated by `docs/test-tracks/tools/gen_tracks.py`, which carries the workspace's
licence header, from the scenario library under `docs/test-tracks/`. Everything here
is synthetic, on the fictional Vell estuary of `docs/mission/vignettes.md`; nothing was
copied from any dataset and no real site, route, unit, or platform identity appears,
so no third-party licence attaches.

Each set's `metadata.json` records the scenario, seed, and input versions that make it
reproducible. `README.md` in this directory describes the files.

The sets are test fixtures only: they replay through the ingest gateway in
`gungnir-ingest/tests/test_track_samples.rs` and are never linked into or shipped with
a binary.
